content.short: Building the Pigs Fly Token, NFT's, P2E Game, Social Media Platform and DEX. They said of crypto: "When Pigs Fly" Well, The Pigs Are Here!
content.description:
The Pigs Fly Project was inspired by being told of the crypto space: “When Pigs Fly.” Well, we are here to say the pigs are here and they are taking off. The Cardano blockchain is the premier blockchain in the entire space and this is why we have chosen to build our Pigs Fly ecosystem on Cardano.

The total supply of $PGFLY is 333,333,333,333.000000. The Pigs Fly Token (PGFLY) Will be distributed for Sale via the ICO and for marketing distribution and contest rewards via Air Drop. 30% of $PGFLY will be allocated to the Initial Coin Offering. 10% will be allocated for Air Drop. Liquidity will have an allocation of 20% of the total supply to be delegated to liquidity pools, DEX’s and CEX’s. Staking, in numerous forms of stake pools, will have an allocation of 20% of the total supply. The treasury will be used for initial gaming rewards and other uses, which has an allocation of 10% of the total $PGFLY supply. The final 10% of the supply is delegated to The Pigs Fly Project Team and to be split evenly amongst the core four team members listed above. $PGFLY will be used to enter games and as the reward for mentioned P2E game. $PGFLY will also be used as payment in our Social Network System and the power behind the DEX.
